newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer raises price in tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer raises price in tender offer.

text.p: Pioneer Cos Inc on Monday said its Pioneer Americas Acquisition Corp unit increased the purchase price in its tender offer for its $135 million outstanding 13-3/8 percent first mortgage notes due 2005.
The purchase price was raised from 119.50 percent to 119.75 percent, resulting in an aggregate purchase price of $1,226.48 per $1000 principal amount of notes.
The price includes accrued and unpaid interest, assuming a payment date of June 19, and a $30 consent fee.
The company added that the expiration of the previously announced consent solicitation has been extended from 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on June 2 to 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on June 3.
The tender offer, which was announced on May 19, expires June 16, 1997.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp is dealer manager for the tender offer and consent solitication.
